skill.name: git
skill.description: Use read-only Git commands to inspect repository status, changes, history, branches, remotes, and tracked files.

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline backticks around Git command examples. The skill is a read-only Git inspection guide, and I found no prompt injection, hidden execution logic, or data exfiltration intent.

3. **Branch detection**: Use `git branch --show-current` to identify the current branch
4. **Platform detection**: Use `git remote -v` to determine if GitHub or GitLab, then use the approp

content.value_statement: Developers need fast repository context before changing code. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through read-only Git inspection commands.
actual_capabilities: Checks repository status, current branch, branch lists, and configured remotes.
Reviews unstaged, staged, and combined changes with diff-focused commands.
Summarizes changed files and diff statistics for quick review.
Inspects commit history, recent commits, commit details, and file history.
Shows tracked files and selected commit content for repository exploration.
limitations: It only documents read-only Git inspection commands.
It does not create commits, branches, tags, or remote pushes.
It depends on Git being available in the active workspace.
It cannot replace repository access controls or code review policy.

use_cases.title: Review Local Changes
use_cases.description: Inspect staged and unstaged work before asking an AI assistant to edit files.

use_cases.title: Prepare Pull Request Context
use_cases.description: Collect branch, diff, and commit history details before writing review notes.

use_cases.title: Investigate File History
use_cases.description: Trace commits and blame output for a file before diagnosing a regression.

prompt_templates.title: Check Repository State
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the git skill to summarize the current branch, status, remotes, and changed files.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use read-only Git commands to compare staged and unstaged changes, then summarize the main risks.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Recent History
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect recent commits on this branch and explain the main development themes in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Branch Delta
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this branch against the base branch, identify changed areas, and note files needing careful review.

output_examples.output: The assistant reports the active branch, clean or modified status, remote host, and changed file count.

output_examples.input: Review my staged and unstaged changes.
output_examples.output: The assistant separates staged work from local edits, then summarizes notable files and review concerns.

output_examples.input: Explain the recent history for this branch.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists recent commit themes, important files, and any unusual changes visible from history.

best_practices: Start with status and branch checks before inspecting diffs or history.
Use short history and summary flags when large repositories may produce long output.
Treat remote URLs and file paths as project metadata that may be sensitive.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for commits, pushes, rebases, or destructive Git operations.
Do not paste large raw diffs when a summary command can answer the question.
Do not expose private remote URLs or repository paths in public support requests.

faq.question: Does this skill modify repositories?
faq.answer: No. The documented commands are intended for read-only inspection of repository state and history.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it review both staged and unstaged changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes separate guidance for staged changes, unstaged changes, and combined diffs.

faq.question: Can it help before a pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. It can gather branch, diff, changed file, and commit history context before review.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The listed commands inspect local Git metadata and configured remotes.

faq.question: What should users avoid sharing?
faq.answer: Users should avoid sharing private remote URLs, internal branch names, and sensitive file paths publicly.
